location_note: Horbat Mazruq, terraced shoulder of a spur south of the Qiryat Ye'arim ridge near Abu Ghosh; map ref. 210133/634104 (NIG, printed p. 250). Converted point lies just inside the Z4 western limit (lon 35.106).
notes: Late Hellenistic-Early Roman village (Areas A1, A2; end of 2nd c. BCE to 70 CE; First Revolt coins 67/68 CE) and a hiding complex in Area A3 that cancelled earlier water installations; author dates the hiding complex to the First Jewish Revolt (66-70/74 CE). The 2014 hoard of 114 First Revolt coins nearby is cited from Ariel, Marco and Betzer 2018; not coded. Walls and terraces not eligible.

features.period: hiding complex prepared and used in the First Jewish Revolt (66-70/74 CE); A1-A2 chambers with the Hasmonean-1st c. CE structures
